text: おたがいに　こうげきを　しあって　たいりょくを　へらして　いくんだ！

structure.jp: おたがいに　こうげきを　しあって
structure.en: both sides attack each other and

structure.jp: たいりょくを　へらして　いくんだ！
structure.en: keep wearing down HP, you see!

patterns.name: 〜あう
patterns.explanation: あう stuck onto a verb says two sides do it to each other. こうげきを しあって = 'attacking each other'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-verb says the action keeps going on from now. へらして いく = 'go on lowering it'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end gives the feel of explaining how things are. へらして いくんだ = 'you see, you go on lowering it'.
